title: Modular functoriality for finite groups
summary: We develop an extension of Deligne--Lusztig theory to certain (possibly infinite type) disconnected reductive groups arising from the special fibers of point stabilizers in the Bruhat--Tits building, which we call \emph{paraductive}. We then compute explicit lower bounds for the Tate cohomology of representations of paraductive groups, relating these to Shintani descent, Lusztig restriction, and the Glauberman correspondence. As an application, using Feng's modular functoriality and Scholze's independence of $\ell$, we compute the Fargues--Scholze L-parameters of non-singular depth $0$…
